comment_data.body:
Can you please clarify what exactly is the issue here? I thought I understood at first, but I have doubts.

Do you mean that:
- [`MiniClueBorder`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L711), [`MiniFilesBorder`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L747), and [`MiniPickBorder`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L793) link to `NormalFloat` and not `FloatBorder`? The original idea was for them to have the same background as the rest of their floating windows.

    'mini.base16' does not define all built-in groups and relies a lot on default links. The `FloatBorder` on Neovim<0.10 was linked to `Normal` instead of `NormalFloat`, so explicit linking to `NormalFloat` in those groups was necessary. Now - probably not so much.

- [`MiniClueTitle`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L717), both of [`MiniFilesTitle[Focused]`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L753-L754), and [`MiniPickBorderText`](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/6a224ddd28b4b21a488d6d87e1c2643a029caaa4/lua/mini/base16.lua#L795) define their own attributes and not link to `FloatTitle`? Because they intentionally provide different highlighting. In particular, with bold text.

    'mini.base16' does not define all built-in groups and relies a lot on default links. The FloatBorder on Neovim<0.10 was linked to Normal instead of NormalFloat, so explicit linking to NormalFloat in those groups was necessary. Now - probably not so much.

  • MiniClueTitle, both of MiniFilesTitle[Focused], and MiniPickBorderText define their own attributes and not link to FloatTitle? Because they intentionally provide different highlighting. In particular, with bold text.

reply_data.body: Hey @echasnovski! So the `Float[Title/Border]` looks like the below picture in `minicyan`. Basically, since no colors are set for background for `Float[Title/Footer]`, they look very odd and don't blend at all with the float background. I know you already mentioned that it is best for them to remain the same, but can you just think about it one last time. The only problem is the background color of `Float[Title/Border]`. Also, if you do come to a conclusion on changing it then just setting the background color for `FloatTitle`, then linking it to `FloatFooter`, `MiniPickBorderText` and `MiniFilesTitle` would make all the title groups more generic. The only exceptions would be `MiniFilesTitleFocused`, `MiniClueTitle` and `MiniPickPrompt[Caret/Prefix]` which can have the bold version of `FloatTitle` colors which will be explicitly defined as you mentioned. Besides, I apologize for bringing this topic up many times even though I could just override the color schemes myself which I am currently doing, I just thought doing it this way would result in better experience and hence I am writing this.
